NO_GITHUB.text: Add a GitHub profile link to improve recruiter visibility and showcase code.

NO_LINKEDIN.text: Add your LinkedIn profile to establish professional presence.

NO_EMAIL.text: Add a professional email address so recruiters can contact you.

NO_PHONE.text: Add a phone number to allow for quick recruiter screening.

MISSING_EXPERIENCE.text: Your resume is missing an Experience section. Add your work history or relevant projects.

MISSING_EDUCATION.text: Add an Education section to highlight your academic background.

TOO_MANY_BULLETS.text: Some roles have too many bullet points. Keep it to 3-6 highly impactful bullets per role.

TOO_FEW_BULLETS.text: Expand on your experience by adding more detailed bullet points (aim for 3-6 per role).

POOR_READABILITY.text: Some bullet points are too wordy. Break them down or make them more concise.

LACKING_KEYWORDS.text: Your resume lacks key technical skills required for your target role. Include more specific technologies.

LOW_IMPACT.text: Quantify your achievements. Add numbers, percentages, or dollar amounts to demonstrate scale.

DUPLICATE_CONTENT.text: Avoid repeating the same action verbs or structures across multiple bullet points.

MULTI_COLUMN_LAYOUT.text: Avoid multi-column layouts as they often confuse older ATS systems. Stick to a single-column format.
